title: custodian job file v1
description: A job folder's own file: every key optional.

id.description: The job's id, given when it starts.

kind.description: specs (the folder's spec files, the default) or a job template's kind (triage).

origin.description: For an imported job: the digest of the bundle it came from.

count.description: Count the job's routes at open, after each step that changes code, and at close.

routes.description: A route counted (crate:<name>, decl:<name>, *); the template's count_route, else the workspace. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

task_id.description: The task this run writes its history records into (.custodian/data/history/<task_id>/), given when it starts.

revision.description: The revision of the task this run is: base, fix1, ...

mode.description: bounded (the agent writes no code: change specs only, every touched line covered by a transform receipt) or unbounded (help, nothing refused); the workspace's job_mode when unset.

verify.description: What done looks like, declared up front: test:<name>, reading:<spec> (a reading that must change), check:<which>. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

target_known.description: At open: the job's target resolved to a route or an item through the index.

outcome_known.description: At open: the job declared its verification.

base_commit.description: The commit the job opened at (git rev-parse HEAD at job start): the base a failing test is judged against, and where test --affected measures the job's change from.

baseline.description: Run the tests the target reaches at open, and keep their outcomes as the job's baseline.

allow_file.description: A file the job may touch that no operation writes (a test's expected output, a fixture), as a glob from the root. Repeats: one value per line, in order.
